Our office met with Brooke Burris of The Formation Project, an organization developing data-driven strategies to stop human trafficking and empower survivors.

Partnering with healthcare, law enforcement, and community organizations and guided by data, they help survivors move from crisis to prosperity while driving systemic change to end exploitation.

We know the importance of standing with women, children, and survivors who have been exploited. They deserve more than sympathy. They deserve sy

The VA spends nearly $1 BILLION a year on software, with insufficient tracking to ensure these resources are being used efficiently.

Duplicate licenses. Unused licenses. Millions in preventable waste. No accountability.

Our Veterans Affairs Management and Oversight of Software Assets (VAMOSA) Act fixes the problem. A complete inventory, no duplication, and every dollar serving our veterans, not bureaucratic inefficiency.

Video

MACE WIN: $25.9 million secured for the Lowcountry Rapid Transit project.

The Lowcountry is one of the fastest-growing regions in the country. Our roads and transit systems must keep up, and this grant is ensuring they do.

Lowcountry Rapid Transit will connect Ladson, North Charleston, and downtown Charleston with a modern, reliable system built for the way SC01 actually moves. Less congestion, better access to jobs and services, safer, more dependable transportation for the communities needin

We are fortunate to have an administration and a President who will NEVER leave American troops behind.

Proven this weekend: No. Man. Left. Behind.

“What kind of panties do you wear?"

“I know what I want and won’t stop until I get it."

These are just a few of the DISGUSTING alleged texts Tony Gonzales sent to a staffer years before his affair with another aide who later took her own life by setting herself on fire.

This is now the second reported staffer Gonzales targeted. Hundreds of lewd, relentless texts. Pressing her for nude photos. Asking what she wears to bed. And when she said no, he kept going anyway.

Why are predators protecte

The United States has the GREATEST military in the world.

With strong leadership and unwavering values, one thing is certain: no man is ever left behind.

God Bless America and God Bless our Troops.

We were one of the original four Republicans to vote for the Epstein Files Transparency Act.

We sent letters to the DOJ and SDNY demanding answers and unredacted documents.

We moved to subpoena Pam Bondi to appear before the Oversight Committee.

We questioned the Clintons for hours about their ties to Jeffrey Epstein.

No one works harder to deliver justice for victims, provide transparency to the American people, and hold predators accountable, no matter who they are.

This will be a movie one day. Insane challenges. Incredible success. Unlike anything we've ever seen. 🇺🇸


The White House (@WhiteHouse)

🚨“WE GOT HIM! My fellow Americans, over the past several hours, the United States Military pulled off one of the most daring Search and Rescue Operations in U.S. History, for one of our incredible Crew Office Members, who also happens to be a highly respected Colonel, and who I am thrilled to let you know is SAFE and SOUND!” - President Donald J. Trump 🇺🇸

I want an Attorney General who will make arrests, who will prosecute, and who will put criminals in jail.

And I want ALL the Epstein files released. 

No more two-tier system of justice.
Attorney General or not, our subpoena still stands. We still have questions we want answered.
The top prosecutor MUST hold predators accountable. The American people deserve answers.

We’re praying for our servicemembers overseas right now and for the aircrew whose plane was shot down in Iran today. 

It is far past time we bring our troops home.

During our time in Congress, we have never voted to raise your taxes.

We will never support legislation taking more money from hardworking Americans. Your money belongs in your pockets, not Washington’s.

South Carolina STRONG.

The United States does not abandon the men and women who answer its call. Not on the battlefield. Not ever.

Many unconfirmed reports on the F15 rescue and evacuation operation tonight - please PRAY for our soldiers - and all American troops in harms way. Please PRAY for the safe return of every single one and PRAY for those who sacrificed it all.

GOD BLESS AMERICA. 🇺🇸
We haven’t forgotten the 357 members of Congress who voted to kill our resolution and keep congressional sexual harassment records buried, and you shouldn’t either when they ask for your vote.

Our veterans gave everything. The least we can do is give them a functioning VA.

We introduced the Accountable Leadership for Veterans Act to cut through the bureaucracy holding the VA back and ensure leadership is held accountable. Empty leadership positions and too few appointed officials in senior roles means delayed care, broken promises, and veterans left waiting.

Veterans have been paying the price for Washington’s dysfunction. It needs to end.

Lead with accountability and serve our vet

We met with the DaVita Flower Town Dialysis Center's Home Training team to discuss legislation in Washington directly impacting their work.

What they do is not just medical care. It is life-sustaining work. The policies coming out of Washington determine whether they can keep doing it.

We will always make sure the voices of Lowcountry healthcare workers are heard in Congress, loudly and clearly.

South Carolina STRONG.

Luke 24:6 "He is not here; He has risen!"

No greater love. No greater sacrifice.

Saved by His grace, may we live like we mean it. ✝️
